title: BidiLint configuration
description: Configuration for the BidiLint RTL localization linter. JSON comments and trailing commas are accepted by BidiLint.

$schema.description: Optional URL of this schema for editor completion.

baseCulture.description: Source culture that translated resource sets are compared against. Defaults to en.

include.description: Glob patterns, relative to the config file, selecting files to lint. An empty list includes all supported locale files.

exclude.description: Glob patterns, relative to the config file, excluding files or directories.

layouts.description: Additional directory names that behave like locales, i18n, or translations for layout detection.

files.description: Explicit mappings for locale files whose names or locations do not follow a supported convention.

path.description: File path relative to the config file, or an absolute path.

culture.description: BCP-47 culture of the file, such as en or ar-EG.

resourceSet.description: Logical set name shared by the base and translated files that should be compared.

rules.description: Severity and rule-specific options for configurable lint rules.

ignore.description: Audited suppressions. Every entry requires a reason and at least one selector. BidiOverride and InvisibleControl additionally require an explicit rule selector; path-, culture-, or key-only entries never suppress security findings.

allowLatin.description: Brand and glossary terms that do not need bidi isolation. A string is an exact, case-sensitive term.

rtlCultures.description: Additional BCP-47 cultures that should be treated as right-to-left.

isolationWrappers.description: Additional HTML/XML element names that isolate their content for bidi purposes, such as x-bidi. Built-in bdi and code, dir="ltr", and LRI/FSI/RLI controls are always recognized.

placeholderDialects.description: Placeholder syntax to understand. auto infers a dialect from the format and value; dotnet, icu, printf, i18next, angular, rails, javascript, and mustache select one explicitly; none disables placeholder comparison.

numeralPolicy.description: mixed flags strings using more than one recognized numeral system; allow disables the check; western, arabic-indic, and extended-arabic-indic enforce one system.

isolationStyle.description: isolate requires bidi isolate controls in values; external declares that the UI isolates text and disables UnisolatedLatin.

baseline.description: Baseline file path relative to the config file, or an absolute path.

failOn.description: Findings threshold for exit code 4. Defaults to error.

color.description: Use ANSI color when stdout is a terminal. NO_COLOR and --no-color still win.

quiet.description: Print only errors in text output.

maxWarnings.description: Fail when the warning count exceeds this value.

allow.description: Exact, case-sensitive Latin terms allowed by UnisolatedLatin.

path.description: Glob relative to the config file.

key.description: Glob matched against the logical key.

reason.description: Required explanation for why the suppression exists.

expires.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD date. Expired entries stop suppressing and are reported.

cultures.description: Optional culture scope. An empty or missing list applies to every culture.
